# Welcome {.unnumbered}

This wiki is a shared, practical reference for people working in **[lab name]**. It brings together onboarding information, everyday lab procedures, and methods guidance in one place.

The source is organized as small Markdown-based chapters. You can edit the relevant chapter directly on GitHub; the published site is rebuilt automatically when the change reaches the `main` branch.

## How to use this wiki

- Use the searchable contents in the sidebar to find a topic.
- Treat time-sensitive or institution-specific details as items to verify before acting.
- If something is missing or unclear, add a note to the relevant chapter or contact **[wiki maintainer / lab contact]**.
- Do not put passwords, personal data, confidential participant information, or restricted internal documents in this folder.

## A note about the draft

This is a starter skeleton. Replace bracketed text such as **[lab name]** with confirmed information, and review the local guidance with the relevant lab or university contact before relying on it. Each chapter has prompts and starter text intended to make contributions easy.

## Contributing

Open the chapter you want to update in the GitHub repository, select **Edit this file**, and commit your Markdown changes or submit a pull request. GitHub Actions rebuilds the full book after changes reach `main`. See [README.md](README.md) for instructions on adding chapters and setting up the site.
